title: How O-Rings and Vacuum Seals Work in Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment: Choosing Materials (Such as FFKM) and Dealing with Leaks
excerpt: This article explains how O-rings seal a vacuum in semiconductor manufacturing equipment, covering grooves, squeeze, materials, and degradation. It separates real leaks, virtual leaks, permeation, and outgassing, and connects them to isolating causes with pressure history and He testing, and to confirming recovery after replacement.
